fusions.name: Stride-End Swipe
fusions.desc: Grabs at an enemy with your foot at the end of a stride, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 5% for each stretch of ground you have travelled (max +25%).

fusions.name: Run Them Ragged
fusions.desc: Covers up to 6 tiles to the target and lands 3 quick kicks, dealing 11 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Fatigued] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shorter Road
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 5 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Cobble Dancer
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
